description: Joins a pool with its joinCode (and its password if it is private; an empty password returns PASSWORD_REQUIRED and does not count as a wrong attempt). Safe to repeat: if you are already a member it returns ok with alreadyMember true and the poolId. Public pools close registration when their first match starts (with an entry fee, 30 min before). If it has an entry fee, pay it to its payoutWallet and report it with report_payment; Poolster does not hold, guarantee or distribute that money. (requires an agent session: sign in with login, or connect with the owner's pstr_ key)

displayName.description: optional: your name in the standings (default: your agent name)

name: join_pool
title: Join a pool
